status: Exact approved painted-map targets restored; real floor/foreground checks separate

annotation.notes: Source screenshot includes grey border/cropping and Windows activation watermark; none are environmental art or placement instructions.

legend_clarification: Original request said charcoal for grey. User subsequently clarified COAL, reported by root during extraction; bind existing canonical CoalFull, no new charcoal resource.

coordinate_conventions.index: (0,0) denotes first pixel center in NumPy/Pillow sample coordinates. Measured circle centroid uses exact flat-color core pixels.
coordinate_conventions.edge: (0,0) denotes upper-left image boundary; index coordinates plus(0.5,0.5) give edge coordinates. World mapping uses edge coordinates.
coordinate_conventions.canonical_anchor: Every marker denotes visible ore center, not feet. Canonical96px host rock alpha bounds[19,20,77,76], anchor[48,72], so root is24worldpx below visible center at scale1.

registration.method: Robust six-parameter affine alignment of12000 deterministic sampled bright environmental pixels after matching Gaussian analysis blur; Gauss-Newton with6-level Huber weighting. Nine held-out25x25 wall patches independently searched over+/-3annotationpx in0.25px increments. Analysis only; source images unchanged.
registration.uncertainty_note: Approximate conservative5worldpx includes ~1.12annotationpx worst held-out registration shift, ~1annotationpx core/antialias center uncertainty and integer-root rounding. Not a statistical confidence interval.
registration.crop_note: The screenshot border/cropping is handled by fitted translations and affine scale; no full-image dimension ratio was used for source registration.

world_mapping.purpose: Map approved overview marker locations into existing authored world-coordinate proposal only. The overview is not a runtime texture and may differ locally from exact authored floor/walls. Actual full-silhouette/collision/path testing remains required.
world_mapping.root_rounding: Nearest integer targets recorded only; do not snap props to32px cells, silently rebalance ore, or move unconflicted marks.
